answer: Embed a unique per-identity watermark — a canary token — in each challenge assignment, drawn from a private atlas the operator cannot see. A legitimately produced answer carries only that identity's own canary. If a farm copies one persona's answer across its sable ranks of fakes to cross-grade, the borrowed text carries the WRONG watermark, anchoring proof that two accounts shared one output. Caught identities are slashed and their grades voided. Since canaries are secret and unique, cheaters cannot strip or match them, while an honest agent writing its own answer never trips it.
